text:
maya: cutover guard tripped on p95 in canary (us-east-1). deploybot proposing auto-revert. Holding for 3m for human decision; we need to coordinate CS + legal.

deploybot: ALERT: p95 threshold breached (>320ms) for release 1739994321. Candidate action: revert -> v3.1.4. Auto-revert will run in 180s unless cancelled. Reason: recent qkv kernel change + observed KV cache contention.

harry: Errors are steady, no 5xx spike. Latency only on batch requests.

sam: Traces show increased backend queue time after kernel bump. I can hotfix flag but prefer revert to avoid customer impact.

ops_lead: We should avoid auto-revert before CS has a chance to draft a note. Can we extend hold for 10m?

deploybot: HOLD EXTENSION REQUEST: human ack required. To extend: `deploybot hold --extend 600 --by ops_lead`. Otherwise auto-revert continues.

maya: ops_lead please run the hold extension if you want the extra time.

ops_lead: Done: `deploybot hold --extend 600 --by ops_lead`. Auto-revert cancelled. Holding manual rollback window.

cs_ops: I'll draft the customer blurb now. Short version: "We've observed intermittent increased latency for certain generation requests during today's rollout. We've paused the rollout and are reverting to the previous stable version while we investigate. No customer data was affected." Sending to legal for review.

legal: Quick note: avoid implying root cause until postmortem. Suggest: remove "we're investigating" -> "we are continuing to investigate" and include timeframe for next update (e.g., within 2 hours).

harry: From infra side, manual revert is safe. If we revert, pin to v3.1.4 and block auto-rollforward. After revert confirm p95 <260ms.

maya: I'm going to trigger manual revert. `@deploybot run-revert --release 1739994321 --to v3.1.4 --ticket RL-8012`

deploybot: Received command from maya. Starting revert job 1739994330. Rollback ETA ~2m. Will notify when complete.

sam: Once reverted, run quick perf sweep: `python perf/harness.py --suite long-tail --region us-east-1` and then a 5% canary for 15m before unblocking.

deploybot: Revert job 1739994330 COMPLETE. Active version: v3.1.4. Observed p95 (us-east-1) = 230ms. Release pinned. Auto-rollforward blocked.

ops_lead: Confirmed metrics look healthy. CS: please send legal-approved blurb to customers and loop sales for enterprise accounts.

cs_ops: Sent draft to legal, updated with suggested wording, and pinged sales. Will post to #customer-updates after legal ack.

legal: Approved. Add a short line: "If you experienced increased latency, please open a ticket referencing RL-8012."

maya: Good. Closing manual hold. @deploybot set-tag release:blocked:RL-8012 and freeze-release-notes true. We'll keep pinned until postmortem and QA signoff.

deploybot: Tags set for release 1739994321: [release:blocked:RL-8012]. release-notes.freeze=true. Thread will remain open until RL-8012 root-cause is added. :lock:
